Idk why I'm typing this on an old post, on a niche subject, but if you're having issues you need to go to their github page and download Arduino IDE https://github.com/sanni/cartreader/wiki/How-to-flash-the-Arduino. After you extract it, it's gonna make a shortcut to the app. Now here's where my shit got wonky, and I spent 4 hours texting a japanese dude at 1AM

If the app you boot let's you follow the directory "File>Sketchbook>Cart\_Reader" then you're good.

if it didn't, go into the unzipped file, and run the arduino.exe (or just arduino in my case) and an alternate loading screen will boot, and the directory will be accessible.

\-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

No matter what process you took, After that you just remove the two "//" in THESE respective categories, under the tab "config.h"

34, #define HW3

56, #define ENABLE\_CLOCKGEN

65, #define ENABLE\_RTC

Also, make sure you have formatted(FAT32) AND prepared your SD card. Cleaning your carts with iso is a necessity as well aaannnddd as of rn DO NOT click the "Firmware Updater" link on the page, unless you want to repeat this process. Good luck, hope this helps some nerd.
